testcase.system-out: Scenario: Dismiss the floating ribbon title menu with Escape ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active and the ribbon is floating ✔ When the user right-clicks the floating ribbon title ✔ Then the menu offers Dock to Top, Dock to Left and docks to Right ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the menu closes ✔ And the ribbon remains floating ✔ When the user opens the floating title menu again ✔ And chooses Dock to Top ✔ Then the ribbon returns to the top dock
